title: 第25章 我睇下边个够胆拦我第26章 屠村神秘人的线索
slug: 一年抽取一词条模拟的也可以
lines: 身材魁梧的四当家，看着库房总管和巡逻队长，两边人各执一词，他灵机一动。
“都别废话！
没有人能骗的了我石老四！
只要把你们都干掉，麻烦就没了！”
两边人都傻眼了，这是什么狗屁逻辑？？
四当家一声令下，带领一众帮众，对着两伙人无差别攻击。
“石老四你个蠢货！”
“来黑石帮混真是倒了八辈子血霉！”
外面打的热火朝天，敌我不分。
陈奕在库房里搜刮的开开心心。
感觉箱子里装的满满当当的，足够他短期内挥霍了，陈奕觉得可以撤了。
“该去码头那边，把大春接着，离开这鬼地方了……咦？”
在库房的角落里。
陈奕看见了一副白色面具，面具上有一个黑色火焰图案。
陈奕清楚的记得，那一伙屠了自己亲人，以及整个落丁村的神秘人，脸上戴的面具正是这个样子！
“黑石帮怎么会有这个面具，难道黑石帮参与屠村了？”
陈奕的眼神瞬间凌厉起来，他拖着大箱子，一脚踢开了库房的门。
此时，门外的石老四已经将斗殴的两伙人全部干掉了。
“哈哈哈！
我就说，没人能骗的了我！”
一转头，他正好看见陈奕走出来。
“陈教官，不需要你帮忙了，我已经解决了这帮麻烦的家伙！”
有人提醒他。
“四当家！
不对啊，陈教官好像在偷钱啊！”
石老四看了一眼陈奕手上拖着的箱子，当即面色变得不善起来。
“姓陈的，你这是什么意思？我堂堂四当家，缺钱用的时候都只敢偷偷拿一点，你怎么能一下子拿一箱！”
这是重点么这个？
陈奕无语，这货的智商甚至不配和大春坐一桌。
“这个面具是谁的？”
陈奕将那白色面具拿了出来。
石老四瞄了一眼，摇摇头。
“不认识！
你先把那一箱钱放下，不然别怪我不客气！”
“不认识你就去死吧。”
“呦呵？你小子和帮主吃一顿饭，就不知天地为何物了是吧？你们都别动，我要亲自教训他！”
石老四手持一根狼牙棒，当头砸来。
陈奕不躲不闪，反手一巴掌扫了上去。
灵气护体，那狼牙棒上的狼牙再锋利，只要这东西不是灵器，对方境界又不如陈奕，就很难伤到他。
一个响亮的巴掌声，狼牙棒当场从石老四手上消失了。
content_en:
The burly Fourth Master looked at the warehouse manager and the patrol captain, both of whom had different opinions, and he had an idea.
"Don't talk nonsense!
No one can deceive me, Shi Laosi!
As long as I kill you all, the trouble will be gone! "
People on both sides were dumbfounded. What kind of bullshit logic is this? ?
The fourth leader gave an order and led a group of gang members to attack the two groups indiscriminately.
"Shi Laosi, you idiot!"
"Coming to the Blackstone Gang is really bad luck for eight lifetimes!"
The fighting was raging outside, with no distinction between friend and foe.
Chen Yi searched happily in the warehouse.
It felt like the box was full, enough for him to splurge in the short term, so Chen Yi felt that he could withdraw.
"It's time to go to the pier, pick up Dachun, and get out of this damn place... Huh?"
In the corner of the warehouse.
Chen Yi saw a white mask with a black flame pattern on it.
Chen Yi clearly remembered that the mask on the face of the mysterious man who massacred his relatives and the entire Luoding Village looked exactly like this!
"How come the Blackstone Gang has this mask? Could it be that the Blackstone Gang participated in the massacre of the village?"
Chen Yi's eyes suddenly became sharp. He dragged the big box and kicked open the warehouse door.
At this time, Shi Laosi outside the door had killed all the two groups fighting.
"Hahaha!
I said, no one can deceive me! "
Turning his head, he happened to see Chen Yi walking out.
"Instructor Chen, I don't need your help anymore, I have already dealt with these troublesome guys!"
Someone reminded him.
“The fourth master!
No, instructor Chen seems to be stealing money! "
Shi Laosi glanced at the box that Chen Yi was dragging, and his expression immediately turned unkind.
"Chen, what do you mean? I am the fourth in charge of the family. When I am short of money, I only dare to take a little secretly. How can you take a box at once!"
Is this the point?
Chen Yi was speechless. This guy's IQ was not even worthy of sitting at the same table as Dachun.
"Whose mask is this?"
Chen Yi took out the white mask.
Shi Laosi took a glance and shook his head.
"I don't know!
You put down that box of money first, otherwise don't blame me for being rude! "
"If I don't know you, go to hell."
"Huh? If you have a meal with the gang leader, you won't know what the world is, right? Don't move, I will teach him a lesson myself!"
Shi Laosi held a mace and hit it on the head.
Chen Yi did not dodge, but slapped him forward with his backhand.
Spiritual energy protects the body. No matter how sharp the fangs on the mace are, as long as this thing is not a spiritual weapon and the opponent's realm is not as good as Chen Yi, it will be difficult to hurt him.
"Crack!
! "
With a loud slap, the mace disappeared from Shi Laosi's hand on the spot.
"Crack!
